description: Look up a Resident Advisor venue/club by name (resolved via RA search) or by numeric id, returning its profile (address, capacity, area, top artists) and upcoming/latest listed events.

name.description: Venue/club name to search for, e.g. "Ministry Of Sound". Ignored if venue_id is given.

venue_id.description: Numeric RA venue id, if already known.
